scope: Retrospective fixed sensitivity of saved L1/G1/negative-readout-v3 outputs; not new confirmatory evidence or predictor development. No inference, fitting, training, GPU or source modification of inherited experiments.

g1.limitation: Original per-image G1 R lacks E/S weights; saved pooled values are not independently reconstructed. Alternate uniform-image estimand is descriptive.

negative.limitation: Existing, already-scored evaluation images. Alternative crop/bands change the estimand and are retrospective sensitivity only; no calibration re-fit, new forecasts, gate reassessment or holdout claim. Fixed original full-RGB policies are applied unchanged to crop sensitivity.

thresholds.limitation: Saved E3 scalar records only; threshold labels are not network causal regimes. Pixel/energy/true solver residual gaps remain. This audit is not a primary submission contribution.
